content: Diabetes self-management education and support (DSMES), as endorsed by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), has been shown through research to significantly enhance patients' understanding of diabetes. It improves their ability to engage in effective self-care behaviors, which are critical for managing the condition. Additionally, DSMES contributes to an improved quality of life and better psychosocial outcomes. These include a reduction in anxiety levels and enhanced coping mechanisms for dealing with the challenges of diabetes. Furthermore, DSMES has been demonstrated to facilitate improved glycemic control. This is particularly evident when continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) is utilized, as it has been associated with better A1C outcomes, reflecting more effective long-term blood glucose management.
